title: MONKEY PUDDING
instructions: Take about half a loaf of stale bread. Let it soak in nice milk (as much as you would put for a bread pudding)

several hours. Add a little cream to it. Put in three heaping spoonfuls of brown sugar, two heaping spoonfuls of powdered cinnamon, a few stoned raisins. Cook in the oven with a slow fire until it looks like an old monkey. Serve with a stiff sugar and butter sauce, flavored with a little wine.  --CELESTINE EUSTIS.
